title: 7-Day Adventure in Kenya
prompt: Generate a 7-day travel itinerary for an adventure trip in Kenya, including activities such as safari tours, cultural experiences, and visits to national parks. Ensure the itinerary highlights popular destinations like Nairobi, Maasai Mara, and Lake Nakuru.
use_case: Helps travelers plan an adventurous trip to Kenya with a focus on wildlife and culture.

title: Luxury Retreat in Cape Town
prompt: Create a luxury travel itinerary for 5 days in Cape Town, South Africa, focusing on high-end accommodations, fine dining, and exclusive experiences. Include visits to Table Mountain, Robben Island, and the Cape Winelands.
use_case: Assists travelers seeking a luxurious experience in Cape Town with curated recommendations.

title: Family-Friendly Vacation in Tanzania

use_case: Aids families in planning a balanced vacation with both fun and educational elements.

title: Cultural Journey Through Morocco

title: Historical Tour of Egypt

use_case: Encourages environmentally conscious travelers to explore Madagascar responsibly.

title: Beach Getaway in Seychelles

use_case: Helps couples plan a romantic vacation centered around relaxation and natural beauty.

title: Adventure and Culture in Ghana

use_case: Guides travelers looking for a mix of adventure and cultural immersion in Ghana.

title: Wildlife Safari in Botswana

title: Culinary Tour of Zambia

title: Spiritual Retreat in Ethiopia
